# skyhub_system_stats (Data Source)

Uptime, per-port counters and DSL line statistics (System page).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skyhub_system_stats" "s" {}

output "dsl_down_kbps" {
  value = data.skyhub_system_stats.s.dsl_down_kbps
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `attenuation_down_db` (Number) First downstream band attenuation.
- `dsl_down_kbps` (Number) Downstream sync rate (0 when not synced).
- `dsl_up_kbps` (Number) Upstream sync rate.
- `id` (String) Always `system_stats`.
- `noise_margin_down_db` (Number)
- `noise_margin_up_db` (Number)
- `ports` (Attributes List) wan, lan, wlan24 and wlan5 rows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))
- `uptime_seconds` (Number) System uptime in seconds.

<a id="nestedatt--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Read-Only:

- `collisions` (Number)
- `key` (String) `wan`, `lan`, `wlan24` or `wlan5`.
- `name` (String) Row label.
- `rx_bps` (Number)
- `rx_pkts` (Number)
- `status` (String) Link status.
- `tx_bps` (Number)
- `tx_pkts` (Number)
- `uptime_seconds` (Number)
